Jamali Power System Dataset v1.0.0 Initial public release of an operational and generation dataset for the Java–Madura–Bali (Jamali) interconnected power system. Overview: This repository provides benchmark operational data for large-scale power system analysis and optimization studies on the Jamali interconnected grid. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
